titles.title: A Good Enough Day
titles.plot: In a single day, photographer Tyler Hamilton attempts to overcome guilt and heartache in hopes of redeeming a decade of mistakes.

titles.title: About a Teacher
titles.plot: A teacher tries to motivate unresponsive students when he takes a job at a high school in New York City.

titles.title: Amateur
titles.plot: A gifted basketball player struggles to fit in with his new team at an elite prep school.

titles.title: Anaarkali of Aarah
titles.plot: A village dancer devises a plan to clear her name after being sexually assaulted by a drunken politician while performing in front of a crowd at a festival.

titles.title: Anne at 13,000 ft
titles.plot: Anne hasn't been the same since the jump. While skydiving for her best friend Sara's bachelorette party, the 27-year-old felt focused, free, above it all. Back on the ground, the pressures of her daily life threaten to overwhelm her. Her coworkers at the daycare center are constantly questioning the way she connects with the children. At Sara's wedding, she meets a nice guy named Matt, but she can't help bringing him into ever-more-awkward social situations. As the stressful circumstances mount, Anne prepares for another jump.

titles.title: Another World
titles.plot: Philippe Lemesle and his wife are separating, their love irretrievably damaged by pressures of work. A successful executive in industrial conglomerate, Philippe no longer knows how to respond to the contradictory demands of his bosses. Yesterday they wanted a manager, today an enforcer. Now he must decide what his life really means.

titles.title: Arcadia
titles.plot: A man (John Hawkes) takes his children on a cross-country move to California and tries to hide the truth about their mother's absence.

titles.title: August: The Mirror of Life
titles.plot: A riveting story about a former high school track athlete who's distorted views on love, negatively affects the people closest to him. The Mirror of Life continues to force August to see who he really is and the world around him.

titles.title: Bad Hair
titles.plot: A Venezuelan boy's (Samuel Lange Zambrano) desire to straighten his curly hair leads to friction between himself and his desperate single mother (Samantha Castillo).

titles.title: Better Days
titles.plot: A bullied high school student and a small-time criminal become the prime suspects in the murder of a teenage girl.

titles.title: Blame
titles.plot: A substitute drama teacher at a suburban high school develops a taboo relationship with an unstable student, sparking a trail of jealous sabotage from the student's peers.

titles.title: Broken Keys
titles.plot: A pianist tries to escape persecution in a Middle Eastern town where an extremist group has banned modern living and music.

titles.title: Conjuring the Cult
titles.plot: After finding his daughter dead, David Bryson attends a self-help group to cope with his nightmares. But when a group of mysterious women offer to resurrect his daughter, David's own fate and that of his daughter's soul hangs in the balance.

titles.title: Dark Horse
titles.plot: An odd romance blooms between a chronic underachiever (Jordan Gelber) and a depressed woman (Selma Blair) who has still not recovered from a previous failed relationship.

titles.title: Deliver Us From Evil
titles.plot: After a little girl is kidnapped, a government-agent-turned-mercenary is forced to re-emerge when he learns the incident is closely connected to him. However, when an infamous gangster learns who has entered the country and is finally within his grasp, he goes on a bloody rampage to thwart the ex-agent's rescue mission.

titles.title: Detainment
titles.plot: Two 10-year-old boys are detained by police under suspicion of abducting and murdering a toddler.

titles.title: Dilig
titles.plot: Resa, a young woman, is about to get married to an old, wealthy businessman. She enlists the help of Otso, a gardener, to seduce her fiancé's daughter, Katelyn, and record his escapades with her in order to get her disowned.

titles.title: Distant
titles.plot: After losing his factory job, Yusuf leaves his Turkish village and travels to Istanbul in search of work. There, he lives with his cousin Mahmut, a well-to-do photographer. Yusuf, who assumed it would be easy to secure a position aboard a ship, has little luck in his job search. As the days go by, Mahmut clashes with his countrified cousin over their vast differences in personality -- and, perhaps more so, their uncomfortable similarities.

titles.title: Divorce in the Black
titles.plot: Ava's husband, Dallas, leaves her heartbroken as he deserts their marriage. Dallas' malicious actions unravel as Ava gets a chance to find true love with her destined soulmate.

titles.title: Do Elephants Pray?
titles.plot: The life of advertising executive Callum Cutter (Jonnie Hurn) turns chaotic after he meets a free-spirited French seductress (Julie Dray).

titles.title: A Good Wife
titles.plot: A woman has to decide what to do after she learns of her husband's war crimes.

titles.title: Don't Look Back
titles.plot: After getting divorced, Charlie tries to find love again until she runs into a man from hell who changes her and her friend's lives forever.

titles.title: Double Exposure
titles.plot: When Peter's (Alexander Calvert) ex-girlfriend Sara (Caylee Cowan) shows up in his life unexpectedly, the past and present mysteriously collide. The struggling artist grapples with guilt over what happened to his first love.

titles.title: Earth and Blood
titles.plot: A man who runs a sawmill in Belgium receives an unwelcome visit from a cartel.

titles.title: Eden
titles.plot: In the 1990s France, a young literature student begins working as a disc jockey and witnesses the rise of electronic dance music.

titles.title: Farmer's Bride
titles.plot: A young woman embarks on a forbidden affair after marrying a wealthy farmer.

titles.title: Farming
titles.plot: A Nigerian boy, farmed out by his parents to a white British family, becomes the leader of a skinhead gang.

titles.title: Felicia's Journey
titles.plot: Pregnant Felicia (Elaine Cassidy) has come to England to look for her boyfriend, who she knows works in a factory but not which one. There, she meets an older caterer, Joseph (Bob Hoskins). Joseph is obsessed with old tapes of a TV chef, who was seemingly his mother. However, he is a mysterious character who lies and steals from Felicia while putting on a friendly face. Eventually Felicia begins to stay with Joseph, but things turn from bad to worse when he puts more of his schemes into action.

titles.title: Gabriel
titles.plot: Following his release from a mental hospital, an unstable young man (Rory Culkin) defies his family and goes in search of his childhood sweetheart (Emily Meade).

titles.title: Haze
titles.plot: College freshman Nick Forest wants nothing more than to join a fraternity, while his estranged brother, Pete, leads protests against the Greek system. Nick soon gets an eye-opening experience when he starts to pledge in the wake of a hazing death.

titles.title: I Am
titles.plot: An 11-year-old escapes from an orphanage and must survive on his own.

titles.title: Indivisible
titles.plot: Conjoined twin sisters with lovely voices are exploited by their father, who makes money from their singing. But then one of the girls falls in love, and they learn they can be separated.

titles.title: Jama
titles.plot: "Jama" is a poignant tale of Kalyanam, a young Koothu artist, fighting to continue his father's legacy of traditional folk art amidst rival suppressions, torn between his love, his mother's wishes and his own creative path.

titles.title: My Name Is Hmmm...
titles.plot: An 11-year-old runaway with an absent mother and abusive father disappears on a field trip and finds solace with a Scottish truck driver.

titles.title: La France
titles.plot: A woman searches for her husband during World War I after he sends a letter ending the marriage.

titles.title: La soledad
titles.plot: A Venezuelan man attempts to save his family's home from demolition.

titles.title: Lamb
titles.plot: An Ethiopian boy moves in with relatives and fears for his beloved sheep's safety as a holiday approaches.

titles.title: Love Kills
titles.plot: Lia is in love with her boyfriend, Milo, until she has feelings for their new roommate, Brianna; Milo catches them cheating and Brianna goes missing, things take a dark turn and a menacing sugar daddy becomes the prime suspect.

titles.title: Lowriders
titles.plot: A teenage graffiti artist paints murals on the hoods of lowrider cars to help his older brother win an upcoming competition.

titles.title: Mikey's Army
titles.plot: Sixteen-year-old Mikey unwittingly conjures a trio of guides including a drag queen, an international pop star and an action film heartthrob to help him find the courage and confidence he needs to be honest about his feelings.

titles.title: Mine 9
titles.plot: Miners struggle to survive after an explosion leaves them trapped two miles underground.

titles.title: Mommy
titles.plot: A peculiar neighbor (Suzanne Clément) offers hope to a recent widow (Anne Dorval) who is struggling to raise a teenager (Antoine-Olivier Pilon) who is unpredictable and, sometimes, violent.

titles.title: One Thousand Ropes
titles.plot: When a father reunites with his estranged teenage daughter, he has the opportunity to shape the future of his family.

titles.title: Opus Zero
titles.plot: The story of a composer who looks for the meaning of isolation and silence after losing his dad.

titles.title: Paradise: Hope
titles.plot: A chubby, virginal teen (Melanie Lenz) at a weight-loss camp develops a crush on her doctor (Joseph Lorenz) and becomes determined to seduce him.

titles.title: Peur de rien
titles.plot: Lina arrives in Paris in the 1990s with nothing but her fear and instincts for self-preservation.

titles.title: The Power of One
titles.plot: It's the 1930s, and as the people he cares for die or leave his village, young South African P.K. bonds with much older Doc (Armin Mueller-Stahl). A foreigner, Doc is detained when World War II starts, but from his prison cell he encourages P.K. to learn boxing. As he travels to different bouts, the adult P.K. (Stephen Dorff) forges relationships that anger the state's apartheid government -- but his reunion with his onetime schoolyard nemesis (Daniel Craig) may offer his biggest challenge yet.

titles.title: Shepherds and Butchers
titles.plot: A lawyer (Steve Coogan) takes on the murder case of a prison guard traumatized by the executions he took part in.

titles.title: Still Human
titles.plot: A paralyzed man and his Filipino domestic worker learn about each other as they go about life in Hong Kong.

titles.title: Tableau
titles.plot: Struggling to navigate a promising career, a new romance, and her family life, a photography student confronts notions of love and loss during her senior year of college.

titles.title: The Truth About Emanuel
titles.plot: A troubled teen (Kaya Scodelario) befriends a new neighbor (Jessica Biel) who resembles the teen's late mother and is adrift in a fragile, fictional world of her own creation.

titles.title: Tori and Lokita
titles.plot: A friendship develops between two young people after they are exiled in Belgium.

titles.title: Tramontane
titles.plot: A young blind man is determined to discover his birth origins, so he travels across rural Lebanon to gather minor clues about his true identity.

titles.title: Unforgivable
titles.plot: An author moves to Venice to write a novel and falls in love with a woman he does not fully trust.

titles.title: Us and Them
titles.plot: Two strangers fall in love when they meet on a train.

titles.title: Wedding Doll
titles.plot: A young woman with a mental deficiency falls in love with a factory owner's son.

titles.title: What Maisie Knew
titles.plot: The offspring of a hot-headed musician (Julianne Moore) and an art dealer (Steve Coogan), little Maisie (Onata Aprile) learns the hard way about how difficult divorce can be on a youngster. The quiet, obedient child gets caught in the middle as her self-absorbed parents use her as a pawn in a bitter custody battle. After her parents marry new mates, Maisie finds reason to hope for some genuine affection -- but permanent damage to her psyche may have already been done.

titles.title: What We Do Next
titles.plot: When Elsa Mercado (Michelle Veintimilla) is released from prison after serving 16 years for killing her father, New York City Councilwoman Sandy James (Karen Pittman) and corporate attorney Paul Jenkins (Corey Stoll) are forced to grapple with their involvement in the original crime. WHAT WE DO NEXT is a timely emotional thriller sitting at the intersection of race, class and criminal justice.

titles.title: Workforce
titles.plot: A woman seeks justice when her husband -- a construction worker -- suspiciously falls to his death in Mexico City.

titles.title: Yo
titles.plot: A youth meets an 11-year-old girl who changes his life forever.
